meta.title: Pre-Med (Biology) Study Abroad & International Programs
meta.disclaimer: Compiled from public SUNY Oneonta, SUNY and provider web pages. Prices, dates and deadlines change every term. Entries marked 'listing-only' were confirmed to exist on SUNY Oneonta's partner list but their cost, credit and course details were not published in a form this tool could read. For listing-only entries, the city is inferred from the host institution's usual location and should be confirmed. Always confirm on the program page and with the Office of Global Education (globaled@oneonta.edu) and a pre-health advisor before applying.

programs.name: Pre-Health Seminar & Shadowing - Barcelona (Summer)
programs.term: Summer 2027 Session I or II; 2026 reference term 6/25/26 - 7/25/26
programs.durationText: 4.5 weeks (also 9.5 weeks if combining Session I + II)
programs.creditsText: 3 credits (Perspectives in International Healthcare: Clinical Observation Experience, 300-level)
programs.costText: $8,995 program fee (2026 listing). Sample total budget $11,836 - $14,073 including airfare, meals and personal costs. 2027 price to be confirmed.
programs.eligibility: 1 year of college completed before program start; minimum GPA 2.5
programs.preMedNotes: 60 hours of observational hospital shadowing (5 hrs/day, Mon-Thu, 3 weeks), rotating through departments. Follows AAMC guidelines for ethical shadowing. Strictly observational; no patient care.
programs.housing: Apartment shared room included; private room, homestay and residence hall options for a supplement
programs.deadline: 2026 term closed; check the 2027 term page. Enrollment is limited because of clinical rotations - apply early.
notes: Additional clinical documents may be required, such as a statement of good health and immunization records.
Credit is transcripted by the University of New Haven (CEA CAPA's school of record); confirm transfer with SUNY Oneonta advising.
SUNY Oneonta also lists a 'Europe - Pre-Health' summer program; confirm with the Office of Global Education whether it is this provider.

programs.name: Pre-Health Seminar & Shadowing - Barcelona (Semester)
programs.creditsText: 3-credit health seminar plus up to 4 electives (up to about 15 credits per CEA CAPA)
programs.costText: Not confirmed - see program page for the semester price
programs.eligibility: 1 year of college completed before program start; minimum GPA 2.5 (as listed for the summer program; confirm for the semester)
programs.language: English (study center courses offered in English and Spanish)
programs.preMedNotes: Up to 90 hours of clinical observation across the semester while taking additional courses to stay on track academically.
notes: SUNY Oneonta lists a separate CEA CAPA Barcelona semester program (OGE portal brochure 34470); check whether pre-health shadowing is available through that listing.

programs.name: Pre-Health Seminar & Shadowing - Madrid
programs.term: Summer 2027 Session I, Session II, or Session I + II (Nebrija hybrid); 2026 reference term 5/28/26 - 8/1/26
programs.durationText: 4.5 weeks per session; 9-9.5 weeks for both sessions combined
programs.creditsText: 6 credits for the combined option (3-credit health seminar + 1 elective); 3 credits for a single session
programs.costText: $13,095 for the 2026 combined option. Sample total budget $15,905 - $18,840. 2027 pricing not confirmed.
programs.eligibility: 1 year of college completed before program start; minimum GPA 2.5
programs.preMedNotes: 60 hours of hospital observation (5 hrs/day, Mon-Thu, 3 weeks); one week of intensive coursework before placement.
programs.housing: Apartment shared room included; homestay, private rooms and residence halls for a supplement
programs.deadline: 2026 term closed; check the 2027 term page. Apply early - enrollment is limited.
notes: Airfare ($800-$1,700) and meals ($473-$1,260) are not included in the program fee.

programs.name: Pre-Health Seminar & Shadowing - Rome (with Pavia, Gorizia or Trieste options)
programs.term: Summer 2027: Session I A (Rome) or I B (Pavia); Session II A (Gorizia) or II B (Trieste). 2026 reference term 5/14/26 - 6/13/26
programs.durationText: 4.5 weeks per session (8 weeks for the 2026 combined option)
programs.creditsText: 3 credits for a single session; 6 credits for the combined option
programs.costText: $8,495 for the 2026 single session; $13,095 for the 2026 combined option. 2027 pricing not confirmed.
programs.eligibility: 1 year of college completed before program start; minimum GPA 2.5
programs.preMedNotes: Hospital shadowing with a 3-credit seminar. Multi-site options let you take the seminar in Rome and shadow in a second Italian city (Pavia, Gorizia or Trieste).
programs.deadline: 2026 term closed; check the 2027 term page. Apply early - enrollment is limited.
notes: Excursions to Pompeii or Ostia Antica are part of the Rome center experience.
Shadowing hours shown assume the standard CEA CAPA 60-hour structure; confirm on the Rome term page.

programs.name: University of Trento (Semester and Summer)
programs.language: Italian and English (limited English course selection)
programs.preMedNotes: Other US universities that partner with Trento report that biology is offered but that semester courses in English are limited and some disciplines are mostly in Italian (a minimum A2 Italian level is required by at least one partner). Check the English course catalog for pre-med prerequisites such as organic chemistry or physics.
programs.housing: Student residences or shared flats through Opera Universitaria

programs.name: Traditional and Modern Mayan Medicine (CHEM 3094)
programs.creditsText: Not listed on the faculty-led page
programs.costText: Not listed - ask the Office of Global Education
programs.eligibility: See faculty leader / Office of Global Education
programs.preMedNotes: Course focuses on traditional and modern medicine, so it adds global health and cultural-competency experience. It is a course, not clinical shadowing.

programs.name: Community Health in the Caribbean (ANTH 3994)
programs.creditsText: Not listed on the faculty-led page
programs.costText: Not listed - ask the Office of Global Education
programs.eligibility: See faculty leader / Office of Global Education
programs.preMedNotes: Community health focus; relevant to public health and underserved-population experience for medical school applications.
notes: The destination country is not named on the Oneonta page; confirm before treating this as a specific location.

programs.name: Building Confidence in Science Through Icelandic Excursions (EDUC 3094)
programs.creditsText: Not listed on the faculty-led page
programs.costText: Not listed - ask the Office of Global Education
programs.eligibility: Offered by the Education department; confirm whether non-education majors may enroll
programs.preMedNotes: Science-education course using field excursions. Useful for science communication, but not a clinical or pre-med-specific experience.

programs.name: University of Cape Coast (Semester)
programs.preMedNotes: UCC has a College of Health and Allied Sciences and a College of Agriculture and Natural Sciences; match course offerings to your biology and pre-med prerequisites before applying.
programs.housing: On-campus housing or self-arranged (per another US partner's UCC page)

programs.name: Linnaeus University (Semester)
programs.preMedNotes: ISEP describes the Kalmar campus as offering natural sciences courses. Verify that biology and chemistry courses match your pre-med sequence.
programs.housing: Single dorm rooms with en-suite bathroom and a weekly meal stipend (per ISEP's Linnaeus listing)
